description: This file contains implementation of the profiling graph executor for TorchScript, including functions for optimization passes, profiling, fallback handling, and plan retrieval within the JIT runtime.

classes.name: ProfilingGraphExecutorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a TorchScript JIT executor that handles profiling, optimization, fallback, and plan management for scripted functions.

methods.name: getOptimizedPlanFor
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an optimized execution plan based on profiling and bailout depth.

methods.name: getPlanFor
methods.description: Main entry point to get the execution plan, managing profiling, fallback, and optimization states.

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.description: Returns the current debug state of the executor, including execution plans.

methods.name: runProfilingInsensitiveOptimizations
methods.description: Performs optimizations on the graph that are independent of profiling data.

methods.name: runProfilingOptimizations
methods.description: Performs profiling-specific optimizations, including autodiff graph creation and gradient handling.

methods.name: runNoGradOptimizations
methods.description: Runs optimization passes that do not require gradient information.

methods.name: runNooptPassPipeline
methods.description: Runs a series of passes for a non-optimized graph.

methods.name: getInstantiatedBailoutDepth
methods.description: Calculates the total bailout depth based on the current fusion strategy.

methods.name: replaceFallbackGraphWithFallbackFunction
methods.description: Replaces fallback nodes with calls to fallback functions.

methods.name: createFallbackPathFunction
methods.description: Creates a fallback function from a subgraph.

methods.name: insertFallbackFunctionCall
methods.description: Inserts a call to a fallback function into the graph.

methods.name: clearTheGraphCompilationIntermediateGraphs
methods.description: Clears intermediate graphs used during profiling and fallback.
